children.name: interface
children.helperInfo: ip address and gateway config

children.name: address
children.helperInfo: Description: The IP address of identifier interface Value type: IPv4 address form in dotted quad notation using the default zone xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx. E.g., 192.168.1.5

children.name: prefix-length
children.helperInfo: Description: The IPv4 address prefix length Value type: IPv4 prefix-length, range 0-32

children.name: gateway
children.helperInfo: Description: The gateway IP address of identifier interface Value type: IPv4 address form in dotted quad notation using the default zone xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx. E.g., 192.168.1.1

children.name: dhcp-client
children.helperInfo: Description: The interface DHCP Client application enabled or disabled switch Available input Value - "enabled": Enable interface DHCP Client - "disabled": Disable interface DHCP Client default value: "enabled"

children.name: dhcp-server
children.helperInfo: Description: The interface DHCP server application enabled or disabled switch Available input Value - "enabled": Enable interface DHCP server - "disabled": Disable interface DHCP server default value: - "enabled" for interface 1-40-eth - "disabled" for other interfaces

children.name: interface-type
children.helperInfo: Description: The management interface type . Value type: enumeration - “softwareloopback”: system loopback interface - “oscinterface”: optical supervisory channel interface - “nminterface”: network management ethernet interface

children.name: ospf
children.helperInfo: Description: system ospf

children.name: control
children.helperInfo: Description: The system ospf protocol enabled or disabled switch Available input Value - “enabled”: enable system ospf function - “disabled”: disable system ospf function default value: “enabled”

children.name: router-id
children.helperInfo: Description: The router ID of the remote system Value type: - IPv4 address in dotted decimal notation. E.g., 192.168.1.5 - “”: use system loopback IP as router-id default value: “”

children.name: interface
children.helperInfo: Description: set identifier interface’s attribute for ospf protocol

children.name: retransmit-interval
children.helperInfo: Description: The number of seconds that the local system waits before retransmitting an unacknowledged LSA. Value type: positive integer Value range: 1…65535 Granularity: 1 Units: seconds Default value: 5

children.name: hello-interval
children.helperInfo: Description: The number of seconds the local system waits between the transmission of subsequent Hello packets Value type: positive integer Value range: 1…65535 Granularity: 1 Units: seconds Default value: 10

children.name: dead-interval
children.helperInfo: Description: The number of seconds that the local system should let elapse before declaring a silent router down. Value type: positive integer Value range: 1…65535 Granularity: 1 Units: seconds Default value: 40

children.name: cost
children.helperInfo: Description: The specifies cost of sending a packet on an OSPF interface. Value type: positive integer Value range: 1…65535 Granularity: 1 Default value: 1

children.name: priority
children.helperInfo: Description: The priority to help determine the OSPF designated router for a network. Value type: integer Value range: 0…255 Granularity: 1 Default value: 1

children.name: transmit-delay
children.helperInfo: Description: The estimated number of seconds required to send a link-state update packet on an OSPF interface. Value type: positive integer Value range: 1…65535 Granularity: 1 Units: seconds Default value: 1

children.name: network-type
children.helperInfo: The type of network that OSPFv2 should use for the specified interface. Value: point-to-point | broadcast | non-broadcast default: broadcast

children.name: area
children.helperInfo: Description: The OSPF area of identified OSPF interface Value type: IPv4 address with format xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx | 0 Default value: 0

children.name: neighbor
children.helperInfo: The router ID of the neighbor router

children.name: id
children.helperInfo: The router ID of the neighbor router

children.name: priority
children.helperInfo: The priority of the neighbor router

children.name: state
children.helperInfo: The functional state of the neighbor router

children.name: address
children.helperInfo: The ip address of the neighbor interface

children.name: dead-time
children.helperInfo: The amount of time that remains as the router waits to receive an OSPF hello packet from the neighbor before it declares the neighbor is down.

children.name: interface
children.helperInfo: The interface on which the OSPF neighbor has formed adjacency

children.name: redistribute
children.helperInfo: Description: The ipv4 ospf redistribute.

children.name: route-type
children.helperInfo: Description: The protocol name of OSPF route redistributed to Available input value: - "bgp": BGP protocol

children.name: metric
children.helperInfo: Description: A manual metric value for the redistributed route Value type: positive integer Value range: 0.. 16777214 Granularity: 1 Default value: 5

children.name: route
children.helperInfo: Description: The system ospf protocol enabled or disabled switch

children.name: dest-address
children.helperInfo: Description: The destination IP address of route with prefix

children.name: next-hop
children.helperInfo: Description: The next hop IP address of route

children.name: interface
children.helperInfo: Description: The interface of route

children.name: metric
children.helperInfo: Description: The metric of route

children.name: routing-protocol
children.helperInfo: Description: The protocol of route

children.name: selected-route
children.helperInfo: Description: The route of the dest address forwarding selected or not

children.name: fib-route
children.helperInfo: Description: The route is one of fib table or not

children.name: bgp
children.helperInfo: Description: The system bgp.

children.name: router-id
children.helperInfo: Description: The router ID of the remote system. Value type: IPv4 address in dotted decimal notation, e.g., 192.168.1.5 Mandatory for add

children.name: control
children.helperInfo: Description: The switch to enable or disable the system BGP protocol Available input value: - "enabled": Enable system BGP function - "disabled": Disable system BGP function Default value: "disabled"

children.name: as-number
children.helperInfo: Description: A numeric identifier for an autonomous system (AS) Value type: positive integer Value range: 1.. 4294967295 Granularity: 1 Mandatory for add

children.name: summary
children.helperInfo: Description: The summary info of all bgp peer Value type: string

children.name: bgp-summary
children.helperInfo: Description: The summary info of all bgp peer Value type: string

children.name: aggregate
children.helperInfo: Description: The bgp aggregate.

children.name: address-prefix-length
children.helperInfo: Description: The IP address of the aggregate route with prefix. Value type: <ipv4 address>/<prefix-length> - An IPv4 address represented as either a full address; shortened or mixed-shortened formats. E.g., • fe80:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001:0000 • fe80::0001:0000 - prefix-length 0..128 positive integer by 1

children.name: summary-only
children.helperInfo: Description: enable or disable aggregate with summary only mode Available input value: - "enabled": Enable summary-only aggregate mode - "disabled": Disable summary-only aggregate mode Default value: "disabled"

children.name: neighbor
children.helperInfo: Description: The bgp neighbor.

children.name: neighbor-address
children.helperInfo: Description: The IP address of the BGP peer. Value type: - An IPv6 address represented as either a full address; shortened or mixed-shortened formats. E.g., • fe80:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001:0000 • fe80::0001:0000

children.name: peer-as-number
children.helperInfo: Description: A numeric identifier for an autonomous system (AS) of peer neighbor Value type: positive integer Value range: 1.. 4294967295 Granularity: 1 Mandatory for add

children.name: interface
children.helperInfo: Description: The name of interface connected with peer neighbor Value type: string, format 1-<slot-id>-<interface-name> Mandatory for add

children.name: connect-retry
children.helperInfo: Description: The connection retries times of BGP session Value type: positive integer Value range: 1.. 64 Granularity: 1 Default: 15

children.name: hold-time
children.helperInfo: Description: The negotiated hold-time for the BGP session Value type: positive integer Value range: 1.. 600 Granularity: 1 Units: second Default: 180

children.name: keepalive-interval
children.helperInfo: Description: The keepalive message sending interval for the BGP session Value type: positive integer Value range: 1.. 600 Granularity: 1 Units: second Default: 60

children.name: redistribute
children.helperInfo: Description: The bgp redistribute.

children.name: route-type
children.helperInfo: Description: The protocol name of BGP route redistributed to Available input value: - "ospf": OSPFv3 protocol

children.name: metric
children.helperInfo: Description: A manual metric value for the redistributed route Value type: positive integer Value range: 0.. 4294967295 Granularity: 1 Default value: 5
